home.heroTitle: Research for the One Health era
home.heroLede: A Melbourne-based contract research organization working across human, animal and environmental health — molecular assay development, bioinformatics, genomics-based pathogen and cancer-marker detection, AMR characterization, analytical chemistry, and multi-site research coordination.

focus.heading: Where genomics, AI and field science meet.
paragraphs: We develop genomics- and AI-driven pathogen and AMR surveillance platforms, detection and diagnostic technologies, and AI-based automation — built to move findings from raw sample to actionable intelligence.
Every engagement sits somewhere on the One Health interface: the point where human, animal and environmental health intersect, and where outbreaks, resistance and disease actually emerge.

pillars.title: Human health

pillars.title: Animal health

pillars.title: Environmental health

services.title: Analytical Chemistry

projects.title: Veterinary Pathogen Intelligence Platform
projects.short: Single-tube, multi-pathogen NGS and AI-driven genomic analysis for poultry health — one sample, up to 50 pathogens, a farm-level risk score.
projects.fullText:
A next-generation poultry health surveillance and diagnostic platform that combines single-tube multi-pathogen NGS, AI-driven genomic analysis, and cloud-based reporting to rapidly identify and characterize the major viral, bacterial, and protozoal pathogens affecting poultry.

The platform uses a single clinical sample to simultaneously screen for 30–50 pathogens, including respiratory and enteric pathogens, while also identifying virulence factors, antimicrobial-resistance genes, pathogen strains, and vaccine versus field strains.

An automated cloud pipeline converts sequencing data into actionable veterinary intelligence — pathogen profiles, strain characterization, co-infection detection, AMR risk, farm-level risk scores, and AI-assisted recommendations. A longitudinal surveillance dashboard lets producers and integrators track pathogen trends, emerging variants, and outbreaks across farms.
projects.vision: Moving poultry diagnostics from isolated tests toward continuous farm-level intelligence.

projects.title: Vector-Borne Disease Intelligence Platform
projects.short: A regional surveillance network across the Philippines, Laos and Southeast Asia — predicting outbreaks before they become epidemics.
projects.fullText:
A regional One Health platform for the surveillance, detection, genomic characterization, risk assessment, and early prediction of vector-borne diseases across Southeast Asia. It integrates data from mosquito vectors, humans, livestock, wildlife, and the environment with pathogen genomics, spatial-temporal analytics, and AI to understand how diseases emerge, spread, and evolve at the human–animal–environment interface.

Ongoing work in the Philippines, Laos, and across Southeast Asia is building an integrated surveillance network that combines field-based vector and sentinel-animal surveillance with molecular diagnostics, whole-genome sequencing, environmental and ecological data, and advanced analytics — identifying circulating pathogens and variants, mapping transmission hotspots, and developing early-warning signals for emerging outbreaks.

Starting with diseases such as Japanese encephalitis and other mosquito-borne infections, the platform is designed to evolve into a regional Pathogen and Vector Intelligence System for public health agencies, veterinary services, researchers, and communities.
projects.vision: Moving vector-borne disease control from reactive outbreak response to proactive, predictive prevention.

projects.title: AI-Powered Cancer Intelligence
projects.short: Deep-learning analysis of whole-slide histopathology to predict breast cancer biomarkers, backed by the CMDN Cancer Database.
projects.fullText:
We combine digital pathology, AI, and clinical data to develop intelligent tools for cancer detection and diagnosis. Our current project uses deep-learning analysis of whole-slide histopathology images to predict key breast cancer biomarkers, supported by structured cancer data through the CMDN Cancer Database.

These capabilities can be applied across hospitals, pathology laboratories, pharmaceutical companies, and CROs to support automated image analysis, diagnostic decision support, biomarker assessment, and precision medicine.
projects.vision: Connecting clinical data, pathology, genomics, and AI to deliver smarter, scalable healthcare solutions.
